purpose: World-space turf and modular scenery for lower orthographic views; HUD and player cutouts reused unchanged from v2.

assets.prompt: Use the supplied approved MUTP pixel stadium as the art/style reference. Preserve its chunky pixel-art clusters, stone/wood fantasy architecture, navy/ivory and burnt-rust accents, warm torches, mature crowd and game-like scale. This is a reusable world-space scenery asset for an exact, end-on ORTHOGRAPHIC match pitch at 40 degrees above ground, zero yaw. Parallel projection: constant width at every distance, NO vanishing point or converging sidelines. Make one square seamless TOP-DOWN turf texture tile. Only layered green pixel grass with subtle connected darker and lighter patches, a few natural bare-earth accents. Match the supplied turf palette and pixel density closely. Texture fills the entire image, can repeat in both directions without a visible seam. No grid, chalk, shadows of structures, stadium, player, ball, words or UI. Opaque image.
